subject: Pricing follow-up: committed-use & startup discount options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Steve Park <steve@deepfin.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + pricing inputs (post-call)

Hi Elena — great to meet you and Steve on the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

What we heard:
- Primary use: document summarization + personalized recommendations in the DeepFin product.
- Pilot: targeting ~20M tokens/month for a 6–8 week pilot.
- Production ramp: 150–250M tokens/month within 3–6 months after successful pilot.
- Key asks: committed-use pricing options, startup program eligibility, and multi-year incentives.

Questions we still need to finalize pricing:
1) Confirm expected steady-state monthly token volume (best estimate and low/high).
2) Target unit economics you want to hit (target $/1M tokens).
3) Any budget constraints / procurement cadence we should know about (PO timing, fiscal quarter).

Initial info from our side:
- Baseline list pricing (non-committed): $450 / 1M tokens (inference).
- Rough committed-use guidance: typical discounts range 15–35% depending on term and volume; startup program can add an extra 25–40% credit in year one for eligible companies.

I attached a short pricing summary for reference (Redwood_pricing_summary.xlsx). If you can reply with the three items above, I’ll put together a concrete two-option proposal: a 12-month committed plan (sized to your steady-state) and a 24-month option with deeper unit-econ examples.

Proposed next steps:
- Elena: confirm steady-state target and target $/1M tokens by EOD Wed.
- Marissa: draft proposal and cc Ben (Sales Director) for discount approvals.

Thanks — happy to hop on another 20–30m if that’s easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below:

1) Steady-state token volumes (reasonable expected path):
- Pilot: 20M tokens/month (month 0–2)
- Ramp: 50M (m3), 100M (m4), 150M (m5), 200M (m6), target 250M by month 9
- For committed-use we’d be comfortable committing to a floor of 150M tokens/month for 12 months if the economics work.

2) Target unit economics: ideally in the $250–$350 / 1M tokens range at scale. Our CFO is modeling target TCO around $60k–$80k/month at steady-state (that maps to the 150–250M range).

3) Budget / procurement: procurement prefers annual PO with 30–45 day payment terms. We’d like to align start of committed billing with calendar quarter if possible (Q1 start preferred).

We’re a seed-stage company (YC S20) — interested in any startup program benefits (credits / larger % off first year).

Attached a short product requirements doc with expected throughput and latency SLOs (DeepFin_requirements.pdf).

Next: could you send a quote with two clear options (12-month commit @ 150M/mo floor, and 24-month at 150M/mo) plus a pilot plan for the first 2 months? Also include the startup program scenario (year 1 credits).

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product | DeepFin
elena@deepfin.ai

Thanks Elen a — great detail, this is super helpful. Below are two concrete options plus the startup scenario so you can see the unit-econ math side-by-side. I’ve cc’d Ben to confirm discount approvals/limits.

Assumptions / baseline:
- Baseline list: $450 / 1M tokens (inference).
- Your steady-state test case: 150M tokens/month (floor) up to 250M/month at scale.

Option A — 12-month committed-use (150M tokens/month floor)
- Commitment: 150M tokens/month (1,800M tokens/year)
- Approved discount (indicative): 25% off list -> effective $337.50 / 1M tokens
- Example cost at 150M/mo: 150 * $337.50 = $50,625 / month
- Notes: 30–45 day invoicing; quarterly meet for usage review; annual true-up if overage.

Option B — 24-month committed-use (150M tokens/month floor)
- Commitment: 150M tokens/month (3,600M tokens over 24 months)
- Indicative discount: 35% off list -> effective $292.50 / 1M tokens
- Example cost at 150M/mo: 150 * $292.50 = $43,875 / month
- Notes: longer term gives deeper unit-econ and predictable capacity.

Startup program (year 1)
- Eligibility: YC-backed startups are eligible for an additional credit / discount bundle in year one. Typical structure: 30–40% credit against usage in year one, plus a $10k platform credit for onboarding.
- If applied on top of Option A (12mo, 25% committed discount) and taking a conservative 30% startup credit in y1, your effective unit-cost in year one would be ~$236.25 / 1M tokens (computed pre-true-up).

Pilot plan
- 2-month pilot priced at list with immediate credit applied if you sign a committed agreement within 30 days of pilot completion. We can also structure the pilot as a credit-backed pilot to avoid upfront consumption charges.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm which option you want modeled (A vs B) and whether the startup credit applies.
2) Confirm desired billing start date / quarter.
3) If you want the 24-month option, I’ll ask Ben to confirm the 35% band; if you prefer 12-month with a slightly deeper concession we can discuss ramp-based true-up clauses.

I’ll draft a short term-sheet/quote once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
